theorems.name: Submission.dtc_blowUp_testForm_corr
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam), (∀ ω : TestFormOn (dilation x lam '' U) n, ∃ ω' : TestFormOn U n, ∀ y : Euclid P, (ω' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) y = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (dilation x lam y)) ∧ (∀ ω' : TestFormOn U n, ∃ ω : TestFormOn (dilation x lam '' U) n, ∀ y : Euclid P, (ω' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) y = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (dilation x lam y)) ∧ ∀ (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn (dilation x lam '' U) n) (ω' : TestFormOn U n), (∀ y : Euclid P, (ω' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) y = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (dilation x lam y)) → blowUp T x lam hlam.ne' ω = lam⁻¹ ^ n * T ω'
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
